svg.title: Finding the service address, and from it the local jurisdiction
svg.desc: Four kinds of service, each with its own rule, all leading to one service address. Mobile communications service: the customer's place of primary use, which is the residential or primary business street address within the provider's licensed service area. Video and direct-to-home satellite service: the location in Florida where the service is received. Calls billed to a calling card or credit card: the central office location identified by the area code and the first three digits of the originating number. Other fixed services: the location of the equipment where the call originates or is received, or the street address the customer designates as the place of primary use when that location cannot be determined. The service address is then looked up in the Address/Jurisdiction Database or another qualifying method to find the county or municipality whose local tax applies.
